changelog: New voice command: say 'duplicate last word' or 'repeat last word' (or 'শেষ শব্দ ডুপ্লিকেট করো' / 'শেষ শব্দ আবার লিখো') alone while dictating and the last word is written again right after itself — handy for repeating a word for emphasis or a name without re-dictating it. Undo removes just the copy, and the clipboard is never touched (72 commands in Help & Support > Voice commands). Nothing else changed — it never sends a message.
